title: [CON-3] Every access-key announcement needs a CO `billingSig` authorized "under Space state", whic
description: Review finding CON-3: Every access-key announcement needs a CO `billingSig` authorized "under Space state", which DM groups cannot obtain (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:204; spec/04-access-control.md:125, :151. Fix: Specify who registers and countersigns DM access chains, and how "current member" is established without Space state. Q1 (countersign every epoch announcement) and Q6 (agreements are signed by a CO billing DID) do not address DMs. The text as written makes DMs undeliverable: 04:125 says DM groups "do not appear in any Space state document" and 05:204 says "Relays MUST reject an announcement without a valid `billingSig`". Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
